_about: Static-ish metadata for each video source. Filled in by a human; updated when the install changes. Served at /api/export/camera_metadata.json and shipped alongside any CSV downloads.

_units.depth_m: meters below the waterline at mean tide
_units.heading_deg: compass heading (0=N, 90=E, 180=S, 270=W) the camera is pointed when pan_deg=0
_units.pan_offset_deg: added to ptz_states.pan_deg to convert camera-frame heading to absolute compass heading
_units.fov_deg_horizontal: horizontal field of view at current zoom; for PTZ cameras this varies with zoom

wahoo_2.imaging_module: AXIS PTZ (M5525-E or compatible) inside the Octopus housing
wahoo_2.lat_lng_source: SenseStream wahoo_2 deployment metadata; sonde co-located with camera
wahoo_2.depth_m_source: Wahoo Bay staff (Rob Wyre / Dan Zimmerman, 2026-05-01)
